project_title: SPYtick - Free Day Trading Desk Landing Page

rules: Headings MUST use Sora 500/600 with clean white text (#E8ECF4). NEVER use gradient text.
Body text MUST use DM Sans with neutral secondary tone (#8A93A6) for crisp legibility.
All tabular figures, tickers, prices, metrics, percentages MUST use JetBrains Mono tabular-nums.
BANNED FONTS: Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, Open Sans, serif italics.

brand_identity.name: SPYtick
brand_identity.concept: SPY (surveillance, sharp eye) + tick (price tick). Precision optics and crosshair reticle aesthetic fused with pulse/tick motif.
brand_identity.logo_design: Custom inline SVG wordmark where the letter 'Y' in SPY features a subtle crosshair notch cut out, and the dot on 'i' in tick is a sharp upward-pointing tick arrow icon in #00E5A0.
brand_identity.favicon: SVG favicon featuring the custom SPYtick icon (crosshair reticle with accent green tick arrow).

layout_and_grids.hero_section: Full viewport height, starry sky canvas/CSS backdrop with 3-5 CSS animated shooting stars, clean un-gradient hero headline with masked line-by-line reveal animation on load, subtitle, dual CTAs ('Open App' solid accent button and 'See How It Works' ghost glow button), and an interactive 3D mouse-tilt glass card embedding a live Lightweight-Charts candlestick chart + ATR-14 line + live score badges.
layout_and_grids.feature_grid: 'Everything you need. Nothing you don't.' 6 feature cards in a 2-column desktop (1-col mobile) bento grid with custom interactive mini SVG illustrations. NO badges above titles, NO colored left borders.
layout_and_grids.demo_section: 'The Desk in Action' tabbed interactive demo with 4 tabs (Chart Analysis, News & AI Overview, Volatility Dashboard, Alerts Panel) with smooth crossfade animations and interactive tooltips.
layout_and_grids.how_it_works: Vertical staggered timeline with 3 distinct steps: 1. Pick any stock (with search UI animation), 2. Get instant analysis, 3. Make informed decisions.
layout_and_grids.why_spytick: Single wide glass card with 3-4 honest, bold value statements.
layout_and_grids.contact_and_feedback: Two side-by-side glass cards: General Contact (name, email, message) and Feedback/Bug Report/Feature Request form with category selector & optional screenshot upload input.
layout_and_grids.footer: Minimalist Apple-grade glass footer with copyright, brand wordmark, live market status indicator, and secondary links.

motion_and_animations.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll initialized globally across the entire landing page.
motion_and_animations.hero_reveal: Kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal for headline on page load.
motion_and_animations.hero_tilt: 3D subtle mouse-tilt translation effect on the main interactive hero trading desk mock card.
motion_and_animations.ticker_marquee: One slow, smooth editorial market ticker marquee tape featuring major tickers (SPY, QQQ, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, MSFT, AMZN) with live price changes.
motion_and_animations.button_interactions: Button hover: scale 1.02 and subtle glow ring in #00E5A0. NO opacity fades on hover.
motion_and_animations.card_interactions: Card hover: translateY(-4px) and border transition from rgba(255,255,255,0.08) to rgba(255,255,255,0.15).
motion_and_animations.shooting_stars: 3-5 CSS shooting stars with transform-only keyframe animation against coprime tile size starry night background.
motion_and_animations.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by stripping ambient movements for users who request it.

out_list_prohibitions: NO purple-blue gradients or generic tech gradients
NO gradient text under any circumstance
NO AI assistant emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮, 🎯, etc.) anywhere
NO Inter or Space Grotesk font usage
NO colored left borders on cards
NO floating badges above section titles
NO relying solely on generic Lucide icons everywhere; use custom precision SVGs for reticles, candles, and charts
NO raw default Vercel or unstyled Shadcn look
NO custom trailing cursor beam or cursor follower
NO fade-out on hover for action buttons
NO em dashes (—) in marketing copy
NO buzzwords or AI slop fluff
NO grainy paper textures or noise overlays
NO scroll parallax effects (only 3D mouse tilt allowed)
NO confetti or floating party particles
instructions_to_main_agent: All React code should be in JavaScript (.js / .jsx) format.
Ensure 'lightweight-charts' or interactive SVG/Recharts candlestick renderer is implemented for the Hero desk card and Tabbed Demo section.
Ensure Lenis is installed/integrated for smooth scrolling experience.
Implement Sonner toast notification when clicking 'Open App' CTA buttons, displaying a sleek dark toast saying 'Trading Desk App Coming Soon! You are on the early access list.'

Make sure all interactive and key informational elements include `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="nav-open-app-button"`, `data-testid="hero-cta-open-app"`, `data-testid="demo-tab-chart"`, `data-testid="contact-form-submit"`, `data-testid="feedback-form-submit"`).
Ensure the feedback form handles screenshot uploads (client-side file selection preview and toast confirmation) and sending feedback via API endpoints.
Follow all rules in the OUT list strictly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop aesthetic: use precision dark void colors (#06080F), crisp glassmorphism (rgba(12,16,32,0.55)), and sharp custom reticle optics.
DO NOT use dark background color gradients; keep solid abyssal dark void #06080F with starry sky CSS layers.
Never use transparent backgrounds without blur in navigation or sticky headers.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for clean breathing room.
Every button and input MUST include proper hover, focus, and data-testid attributes.
Ensure high contrast WCAG AA compliance for text: #E8ECF4 on dark card backgrounds.
